findings.what: Cover title 女制动员的铁路入行记 is set about 2.5× larger than the titles on the t01 and t03 covers. It runs past the right edge of the cream card and the frame: 路 is cut off at the screen edge and 入行记 is missing entirely. The block is too tall, so the red 专八/精读 seal is pushed up against the inner double border.
Tofu/replacement box in the Chinese line: the first line reads '我觉▯，干这么危险的工作…' where the reference has '我觉得'. The glyph 得 is missing and an empty box shows in its place.

The English and Chinese are about 1.6× larger than on every other screen of the passage. Other short sentences (s31 'It drove you crazy.', s51, s52) use the normal size. Because of the oversize, the English wraps badly: 'The fancy academic / job never / materialized.' (two words alone on line 2). The Chinese is also oversized: '那份光鲜的学术工作始终 / 没有着落。'

The first English line 'I now would' is pushed about 520 px to the right. This leaves a large empty gap at the start of the line, and the next lines ('ride¹ that image²…') start at the normal left margin.

The single vocabulary entry ('1 at peace 安宁；内心平静') is far larger than the entries on every other screen: the badge, headword and gloss are about 1.6× normal. The gloss nearly reaches the right edge of the panel.

The vocabulary panel (badges, headwords swell/crest/tumble, POS and glosses) is about 25–30% smaller than on the neighbouring screens (s20, s23). The panel is mostly empty, so there is no reason to shrink it, and it is harder to read on a phone.

The gloss of vocab #2 'suggest…that 建议（that 从句中动词用原形）' breaks right after the opening part, leaving '（that' alone on its own line with a large empty area to its right. The rest '从句中动词用原形）' follows on the next line. The break should come inside the Chinese, or the whole bracket should stay together.

In the vocab panel, the bold f of 'of' runs into the Chinese gloss: 'a lot of大量' has only about 6 px between the f and 大, against about 15 px between headword and gloss in other entries, so they look joined. The same happens on t01 screen33 ('a handful of少数') and t01 screen44 ('a number of一些').

Cover title far too large: the Chinese title 北极沉船“调查者”号的考古与打捞 runs out of the cream card and off the right edge of the frame, so only 北极沉船“调查… is visible. The rest is cut off and the title is ~2x the size used on the t04/t06 covers.

Whole sentence rendered oversized. The first English line 'Around him, a dozen¹' is pushed up over the header ('TEM-8 READING' row, double rule) and is clipped at the top edge, badge ¹ included. The Chinese translation runs down over the footer (SENTENCE 3/36, progress line) and off the bottom of the frame: only 他四周的海岸线上排列着 / 十二顶红黄相间的帐篷—— is legible and the rest of the translation is missing.
Tofu/missing-glyph box in the Chinese translation: the first line reads 在水▯以下25英尺处 instead of 在水面以下25英尺处 (the 面 character is a blank box).

Abnormal blank gap at the start of the English sentence. 'Artifact¹' begins about 1/3 of the way across the text column, leaving a large empty space at the left of line 1, while lines 2–5 start at the normal left margin.
Chinese line breaks inside the word 名目: line 1 ends …以及其他名 and line 2 starts 目的病；… This tears the word apart and line 2 misreads as 目的 ('purpose').
Chinese line breaks inside the word 吧台: 酒馆里歌声阵阵，酒杯砰砰地顿在吧 / 台上。 The word is split and 台上。 is left stranded on line 2. Breaking before 吧台 would be correct.
Chinese line 1 breaks inside 而非 (…由人类而 / 非黑猩猩选定的…) and ends about 3 characters short of the column width. The connective 'rather than' is split across lines.

Slot word highlighted as part of the phrase. In 'she induced father to² give up…', the object 'father' (the 'sb' slot of 'induce sb to do') is coloured green like the phrase words 'induced' and 'to', as if it belonged to the phrase.

Punctuation oddly spaced in the Chinese: between the closing quote and the opening bracket in “mama”（妈妈）, “papa”（爸爸） and “cup”（杯子） there is roughly a full blank character, so the brackets look detached from the words they gloss.

In the vocabulary panel, 'a set of一套；一组': the Chinese gloss is jammed against the 'f' of 'of' with no visible space, unlike the other entries. The same crowding of the f-hook against 一 appears for 'a set of' on screen43/screen64 and 'a type of一种' on screen52.
The VOCABULARY panel is empty: only the red 'VOCABULARY' label appears in an otherwise blank tinted card (part 2/2 of sentence 19 has no entries), which looks unfinished.

Cover: the title is set far too large. It runs past the card's right edge onto the dark indigo background, '人' is cut off at the frame edge and '的爱妻' is missing entirely (it should read 温馨之家与主人的爱妻). The red 专八/精读 seal has been pushed up onto the card's top double rule. The t10 cover is correct for comparison.

English sentence is rendered at a size far larger than any other screen. Its first line ('…in my face, and the') is cut off above the top of the frame, line 2 overprints the header double rule, and the Chinese translation is pushed down over the footer ('SENTENCE 4 / 54' and the progress line), with its second line cut off at the bottom edge.
Chinese translation line 1 shows a tofu / missing-glyph box in place of 意: it reads '他注□到了'. The reference has 他注意到了。
English line 1 starts with an abnormal blank gap of about 520px, so 'I've seen her fix' begins in the right half while lines 2–5 start at the left margin.

VOCABULARY panel text is roughly 1.6× larger than on every other screen. 'speak v. (表情等)/表达;/流露' breaks into four short lines, the label is crammed against the top, and the last entry ('every bit 每一点；全部') sits against the panel's bottom edge.
English line 1 contains only the word 'The'; 'Australian Beverages Council,' wraps to line 2, leaving almost the whole first line empty.
PART 1/3 shows only 'A Deakin University study' and an empty VOCABULARY panel (label only, no entries). The screen looks unfinished, and the Chinese line already contains 利用经济建模表明 from part 2.
Empty VOCABULARY panel (label only) on PART 1/2 'When, after about two weeks,'. The screen looks unfinished.
Empty VOCABULARY panel (label only) on PART 1/2. In the English, 'him,' sits alone on line 2.
Chinese line 3 begins with a stranded '——' (the dash is separated from 亲手做的 on the line above).
Chinese line 2 begins with '——' (dash at the start of the line).
Chinese line 2 begins with '——' (dash at the start of the line, after 弱点 on line 1).
Chinese line 1 ends with '（我', so the opening bracket and one character are stranded; the rest ('在职期间…') continues on line 2.
Chinese breaks inside the parenthetical: '（至今仍' ends line 1 and '生意兴隆）' starts line 2, leaving line 1 short.
Vocabulary gloss for 'stop short of' breaks inside the word 走到: '没有走 / 到……的地步'.
English line ends 'in 26' and 'countries.' wraps alone, splitting the number from its noun.
English 'the 10 / highest' splits the number from its noun phrase. The Chinese last line holds only '之一。'
Quantity split from its unit across lines: 'one hundred and forty / pounds'.
Chinese breaks inside 天亮前: '在天亮 / 前把分解表…'.
Chinese splits 同卵 / 双胞胎 across lines, and the last line holds only '筹钱。'.
Chinese term split across lines: '演艺 / 经纪人'.
Chinese last line holds only '磁带，'.
Chinese splits 黑咖啡 across lines ('豆子和黑 / 咖啡，'); the last line holds only '咖啡，'.
Chinese splits 意识到 across lines: '便会意识 / 到自己…'.
English line 3 'and framed' is only half the width (large right gap) because 'lithographs (平版印刷画),' is pushed whole to the next line.
Chinese splits 小托架 across lines: '黑胡桃木小 / 托架前'.
The opening quotation mark crowds against the blue 'W' of '“Where'; the two glyphs almost touch.
Chinese splits 惋惜地 across lines: '我惋惜 / 地说。'.
Chinese line 2 ends early at '像你', and '这样的人。' wraps to a short third line.
Chinese '大块头 / 的狗，' leaves a two-character last line starting with 的.
Chinese splits 大宅子 across lines: '一座大 / 宅子里。'.
Chinese splits 高大 across lines: '又从高 / 大杨树…'.
Chinese splits 狗舍 across lines ('…众多的狗 / 舍里，'); the last line holds only '舍里，'.
Chinese last line holds only '打猎；'.
Chinese line 1 ('尽管如此，一百四十磅的体重，') ends about 250px short even though the next words would fit, leaving a visible gap.
English lines 2 and 3 are very ragged ('puppyhood he had' / 'lived the life of a'), each about 450px short, and the article 'a' is stranded at the end of line 3.
Cover title is far too large. Only “北极沉船“调查” fits; it runs past the right edge of the cream card and off the frame, so the rest of the title (者”号的考古与打捞) is cut off.

The whole sentence is oversized (line pitch about 162px against 106px on every other screen). The first English line “Around him, a dozen” is pushed up into the header over “TEM-8 READING” and is clipped at the top edge, with badge ① cut off. The Chinese translation runs down over the footer (SENTENCE 3/36 text and progress line) and off the bottom of the frame.
Tofu (missing-glyph box) in the Chinese translation, line 1: “在水▯以下25英尺处” should read “在水面以下25英尺处”.

Vocabulary panel entries are rendered at a huge size and overflow the panel. The top entries spill above the panel over the header double rule and the “2024年 · Passage Two” text (badge ③ “clue to” sits on the header). The bottom entries (⑦ fervor for 对……的狂热) spill below the panel over the footer and off the frame. Entries ①②⑧⑨ (piece, fish, Arctic, exploration) are not visible, and the “aboard” gloss is broken over 4 lines.
Abnormal blank gap at the start of the first English line. “Artifact① recovery…” begins at about x=630 instead of the left margin (x≈110), leaving about 520px of empty space before the first word.

Wrong highlight on a split phrase. In “induced father to②” the slot word “father” (the sb in induce sb to do) is coloured phrase-green like “induced” and “to” (measured the same RGB). Other split phrases keep slot words black, e.g. screen07 “made his horse comfortable”.
The Chinese word 吧台 is split across lines: “酒杯砰砰地顿在吧 / 台上。” Line 1 ends at about x=1015 while other lines reach about 1120, so “台上。” could have stayed on line 1 or 吧台 could have moved down together.
The Chinese word 名目 is split across lines: “霍乱以及其他名 / 目的病；”. Line 2 then starts with “目的病”, which misreads as 目的 (purpose). Line 1 ends short at about x=1006.
The Chinese word 而非 is split across lines: “由人类而 / 非黑猩猩选定的…”. Line 1 ends short at about x=958, and line 2 starts with a stranded “非”.
小船 is split across lines: “再用从小 / 船上拆下的底板…”. Line 1 ends with “从小” (reads as “since childhood”) and line 2 starts with “船上”.
The idiom 吃了一惊 is split: “…就吃了 / 一惊——”. The last Chinese line holds only “一惊——” after a short line 1.

In “He had at that time② no notion of①”, the green “had” (first piece of have no notion of ①) sits right against the green phrase “at that time②” with no visual break. It reads as one phrase “had at that time ②”, and badge ② comes before ① in reading order.
The vocabulary panel is empty: only the red “VOCABULARY” label floats in the middle of a blank tinted panel (part 2/2 has no entries), which looks unfinished.
The date is torn apart: “on June 3,” ends line 1 and “1853.” sits alone on line 2.
Very ragged English block: lines 1 and 2 (“Small chickens, just” / “setting out on① the”) both end at about x=700, leaving half the column empty above three full-width lines.
Vocabulary entry “a set of一套；一组”: the Chinese gloss nearly touches “of” (about 6px against about 15px for other headword+gloss pairs such as t06 s32 “quantities of 大量的”), so it reads “of一套”.
